findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_email_domain, find_lookalike_domains, analyze_email_headers, verify_email_signature, check_payment_change_request, check_payment_policy · Private data: check_email_domain, verify_email_signature, count_spf_lookups, check_payment_change_request, check_payment_policy, assess_callback_record, verify_callback_record, timestamp_digest, check_dns_propagation · Public sink: check_email_domain, find_lookalike_domains, analyze_email_headers, verify_email_signature, check_payment_change_request, check_payment_policy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_email_domain, find_lookalike_domains, analyze_email_headers, verify_email_signature, check_payment_change_request, check_payment_policy · Private data: check_email_domain, verify_email_signature, count_spf_lookups, check_payment_change_request, check_payment_policy, assess_callback_record, verify_callback_record, timestamp_digest, check_dns_propagation · Public sink: check_email_domain, find_lookalike_domains, analyze_email_headers, verify_email_signature, check_payment_change_request, check_payment_policy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
